run_f_gold: run f_gold to count missing elements in the range between min and max of an array
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple parameter sets to verify correct missing element count
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which counts missing integers in the range from min to max of an array
review_f_gold: review f_gold to understand how it uses a dictionary to track present elements and count gaps
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use a set instead of a dictionary for tracking present elements
